payload.title: Spectral Analysis with Pyleoclim
payload.description: This Jupyter notebook demonstrates the use of Pyleoclim for spectral analysis of paleoclimate data. It covers various spectral methods such as periodogram, Welch, MTM, Lomb-Scargle, and WWZ, and discusses the impact of pre-processing techniques like detrending and regridding on spectral analysis. The notebook uses a dataset of benthic δ18O records to illustrate these methods and evaluates the significance of spectral peaks. It also explores the effects of aliasing and scaling behavior in spectral analysis.
